description: Lossless editing JSON contract for kces.bridge_session.

containerVersion.description: The outer container version, normally 1000 for KCES bridge sessions.
containerVersion.title: VirtualDirectory version
containerVersion.x-meido-edit-guidance: Preserve the decoded value; use 1000 for a newly created current session.
containerVersion.x-meido-game-usage: VirtualDirectory uses this version during MessagePack serialization and migration callbacks.

x-meido-source-evidence.observation: The bridge session is a VirtualDirectory containing session_data and session_id; session_data stores an indexed version, session ID, and hidden menu-file hash set.
VirtualDirectory writes virtual-file byte payloads followed by compressed MessagePack directory metadata using the fixed current indexed layouts.

extraFiles.description: Independent virtual files whose names are neither session_data nor session_id.
extraFiles.title: Additional virtual files
extraFiles.x-meido-edit-guidance: Retain names and bytes only for independent files outside the two reserved paths; a reserved file must use its typed field and may never fall back here.
extraFiles.x-meido-game-usage: EditBridgeSessionData ignores these files, while VirtualDirectory stores their real byte-array payloads.

format.description: The marker for the bridge-session editing envelope.
format.title: Editing format marker
format.x-meido-game-usage: It identifies the JSON wrapper and is not a native VirtualDirectory field.

x-meido-source-evidence.observation: The bridge session is a VirtualDirectory containing session_data and session_id; session_data stores an indexed version, session ID, and hidden menu-file hash set.
VirtualDirectory writes virtual-file byte payloads followed by compressed MessagePack directory metadata using the fixed current indexed layouts.

sessionData.description: The typed MessagePack indexed object stored under the reserved session_data virtual file.
sessionData.title: session_data payload
sessionData.x-meido-edit-guidance: Use normal nullable sessionId JSON semantics; the writer derives the required session_id UTF-8 file from this field.
sessionData.x-meido-game-usage: EditBridgeSessionData reads its version, sessionId, and hidden menu-file IDs when opening the bridge.
